system_prompt_style.note: README says claude_agent 'Sends market snapshot to an LLM' but prompt-building code not in evidence bundle.

env_context_strategy.note: The market snapshot is sent to the LLM; there is no repository-navigation concept. The source code is not in the bundle.

context_compaction.note: No source code available for the LLM strategy.

tool_call_format.note: The README says it 'receives structured trade decisions'. The parsing mechanism is not shown.

tool_count.note: The harness is primarily an MCP server exposing 24 tools to external agents. These are not tools given to its own LLM.

edit_primitive.note: This is a trading domain. The listed tool registry has no file-edit tool.

tool_schema_source.note: packages/nunchi-mcp-manifest/tools.json and generate.py exist, but their contents were not shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: mcp_server.py MCP server (24 tools via FastMCP)
protocol_standardization.note: The system acts as an MCP server. The README also claims Agent Skills standard compatibility.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Every tick: Fetch prices, update ROEs, check Guard, run Pulse, evaluate entry/exit
loop_primitives.note: APEX runs a deterministic tick loop. The LLM (claude_agent) is an optional strategy that makes one call per tick. fixed_pipeline is the closest value.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Every strategy extends `BaseStrategy` with a single `on_tick()` method

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The top-level orchestrator. Composes Radar + Pulse + Guard into a single autonomous strategy
multi_agent_topology.note: Radar, Pulse and Guard are components, not LLM agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: no shared state, no hidden coupling between strategies

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Write tools (`trade`, `run_strategy`, `apex_run`) and mainnet access require explicit consent and gateway-enforced limits.
human_in_loop.note: This applies only to the hosted MCP gateway. The local CLI runs autonomously.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Reads from `$DATA_DIR/apex/state.json` (APEX mode) or `$DATA_DIR/cli/state.db` (strategy mode). These files are written by the trading engine after every tick.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Read agent memory — learnings, parameter changes, market observations.
long_term_memory.note: The system has a memory_engine and a trade journal (trades.jsonl), plus REFLECT. It is unclear whether this memory is re-injected into LLM prompts.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Runs on startup and periodically via watchdog.
state_persistence.note: Reconciliation on startup reloads slot state. Full resume is not confirmed.

self_verification.note: The system has a judge_engine module and REFLECT trade review, but these are not verification of LLM output as the schema defines it.

termination_condition.note: There is also a daily loss limit, which closes the risk guardian but does not end the run.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: `openrouter/auto` | Low-latency/cost-aware default for chat and tool use
cost_controls.note: Applies to hosted inference via OpenRouter auto-routing.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Timeout is computed as `max(120, max_ticks * 60 + 30)` seconds.
timeouts.note: This is the timeout on the MCP apex_run tool.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: These shell out to the CLI and may take significant time.

permission_model.evidence_quote: | `COOLDOWN` | **Blocked** | Allowed | 2+ consecutive losses or drawdown >= 50% of limit |
permission_model.note: The Risk Guardian gates trade actions dynamically.

tracing.evidence_quote: Trade audit trail (`trades.jsonl`) is never archived.
tracing.note: cli/telemetry.py exists, but its contents are unseen.

replayability.evidence_quote: A backtest harness replays historical trades against config variants

eval_hooks.note: This is a trading backtest, not a benchmark evaluation.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Graduated risk response with three states and automatic transitions

open_source.note: The hosted deployment/web-auth components are closed and not in this repo.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Sends market snapshot to an LLM (Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI), receives structured trade decisions.
